title: Revisiting multi-pathway modulation with theophylline derivatives: Targeting STAT3, NF-kappaB, and apoptotic signaling in breast cancer.
authors: Afifi, Ola S; Abdellatef, Amira A; Abd El Razik, Heba A; Shams El-Dine, Shams El-Dine A; El-Tombary, Alaa A; Elrewiny, Mohamed A; Hayakawa, Yoshihiro; El-Yazbi, Ahmed F; Nematalla, Hisham A; Elzahhar, Perihan A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茶碱衍生物抑制STAT3和NF-kappaB信号通路治疗乳腺癌，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Among female cancers, breast cancer is the most prevalent type with a high tendency for metastasis, which makes it compelling to develop new therapeutic modalities in the battle against this disease. For this purpose, a new series of theophylline-based derivatives was designed as dual STAT3/NF-B signaling pathway inhibitors. The most active three compounds (12a, 12b and 17b) exhibited potent inhibition of both STAT3 and NF-kappaB activation in 4 T1 cells with IC(50) values of 4.22-8.21 muM. They also exerted considerable anticancer activity with IC(50) values of 1.53 to 7.68 muM in 4 T1, MDA-MB-231, MDA-MB-468 and MCF-7 breast cancer cell lines. These compounds demonstrated their ability to inhibit breast cancer cell migration, and invasion in scratch and transwell assays, respectively. As a consequence of STAT3 inhibition, compound 12a was able to induce apoptosis via its effects on key apoptotic regulators; caspases-3,9, Bax and Bcl-2. Besides, western blotting of 12a-treated MDA-MB-231 cells confirmed decreased expression of STAT3, p-STAT3, Bcl-xl, c-Myc and NF-kappaB. Moreover, compound 12a reduced tumor volume in a comparable manner to 5FU in an Ehrlich solid carcinoma model. Docking of these compounds into the active sites of STAT3 and NF-kappaB revealed adequate binding patterns, providing further support for their effectiveness. Hence, these compounds proved to possess structural determinants that could be further tuned into more potent anticancer agents for breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 在女性癌症中，乳腺癌是最常见的类型，且具有高度的转移倾向，这使得开发新的治疗手段以对抗这一疾病变得尤为迫切。为此，设计了一系列基于茶碱的新型衍生物，作为STAT3/NF-B信号通路的双重抑制剂。其中活性最强的三个化合物（12a、12b和17b）在4T1细胞中对STAT3和NF-kappaB的激活表现出强效抑制作用，其IC(50)值范围为4.22-8.21 μM。这些化合物在4T1、MDA-MB-231、MDA-MB-468和MCF-7乳腺癌细胞系中也展现出显著的抗癌活性，IC(50)值介于1.53至7.68 μM之间。这些化合物在划痕实验和Transwell实验中分别显示出抑制乳腺癌细胞迁移和侵袭的能力。由于STAT3的抑制，化合物12a能够通过影响关键的凋亡调节因子（caspases-3、9、Bax和Bcl-2）诱导细胞凋亡。此外，对12a处理的MDA-MB-231细胞进行Western blotting分析，确认了STAT3、p-STAT3、Bcl-xl、c-Myc和NF-kappaB表达水平的降低。而且，在Ehrlich实体癌模型中，化合物12a以与5FU相当的方式减少了肿瘤体积。将这些化合物对接至STAT3和NF-kappaB的活性位点，揭示了充分的结合模式，进一步支持了它们的有效性。因此，这些化合物被证明具有结构决定因素，可进一步优化为针对乳腺癌的更有效抗癌药物。
